description: This file defines API client functions for authentication workflows, including login, token refresh, logout, and fetching user info. It contains data models for request and response payloads related to authentication, such as TokenPair, LoginRequest, RefreshRequest, LogoutRequest, TokenResponse, and MeResponse. The core class AuthAPI provides asynchronous methods for interacting with the backend API endpoints for auth operations.

classes.name: AuthAPI
classes.description: Singleton class responsible for handling authentication API requests, such as login, refresh, logout, and fetching user info.

methods.name: login
methods.description: Performs login using email and password, returns a TokenPair with access and refresh tokens.

methods.name: refresh
methods.description: Uses a refresh token to obtain a new TokenPair with refreshed access and refresh tokens.

methods.name: logout
methods.description: Logs out the user by invalidating the refresh token on the backend.

methods.name: me
methods.description: Fetches user information for the authenticated session.

methods.name: mapTokenResponseToTokenPair
methods.description: Converts a TokenResponse into a TokenPair, adjusting expiry times.

methods.name: requireHTTP
methods.description: Ensures the URL response is an HTTPURLResponse, throws error otherwise.
